title: Patch: a signature animation for every Meditative+ and Training Grounds Legendary and Mythic, one concept per card
notes: How cards animate and sound; nothing plays differently. Bob's Plan, Bob, Wisconsin's Strongest Soldier, Scratch Pad, Seance, Tutorial Master, Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition), the Training-Grounds Golem and Goetzmann Game Design each play a signature of their own in place of a shared motif (R3400001): a Unit its own entrance, its text's beat and a standing aura on its tile; a Spell its own cast; a Mythic its own takeover with art that Reduce Motion shows still (summit, canvas, napkin); each its own sound. A bespoke entry may wear an aura, a Unit's aura may stand on its tile, and a signature Spell's cast stands in for the shared entrance, its takeover's tail shorter (R3400000). Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition)'s roll panel shows for 0.76 s inside the Legendary Spell's budget.

player.title: Signature animations for Meditative+ and Training Grounds
new: Every Legendary and Mythic of Meditative+ and Training Grounds now has an animation and a sound of its own.
Bob's Plan takes over the screen with an ink-wash mountain range and a red brushstroke climbing to the summit.
Scratch Pad empties the screen to blank paper with a blinking cursor; Goetzmann Game Design sketches a card on a napkin under canteen lamplight.
Bob, Wisconsin's Strongest Soldier heaves a snowplow and slams it down, and Tutorial Master lands in front of a chalkboard.
The Training-Grounds Golem is lashed together from training posts, its keywords locking on one by one.
Seance rings the chosen card in candles as a spirit rises from it, and Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition) rolls two carved wooden dice.
Bob, Tutorial Master and the Training-Grounds Golem wear a standing aura on their tile: snow, chalk dust and sawdust.
changes: Reduce motion shows each Mythic's own takeover art still behind its card.
Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition)'s roll panel now shows for a shorter time.
